text: Deut.16. 16. , Hebr. from yeere to yeere.
Or, from the time that she &c. Hebr. from her going vp.
Hebr. seed of men. , Num.6.5. iudg.13.5.
Hebr. reuelation of dayes. , That is, asked of God.
Or, returned him, whom I have obtained by petition to the LORD. , Or, hee whom I haue obteined by petition, shalbe returned.
